kind: Publicly bound single-block SHA512 compression AIR

public_encoding.message_bytes: big endian within each message word
public_encoding.exact_length_enforced_by: sha512PublicClaim combines pub.length=128 with actual Air.Holds

formal_claims: Actual public claim implies output equals NearSpecV3.SHA512.compress(public state,public block).
All128 public field representatives are below65536 and all32 decoded words are below2^64.
The public block equals the constrained decoded initial byte block,has128bytes,and every byte is below256.
Canonical word serialization equals Boolean-trace byte decoding.
limitations: Single-block compression only; full-message padding,block chaining,digest serialization and universal honest full-trace completeness remain.
Public API uses canonical field representatives; unrestricted external integer-to-field casts are not an injective serialization.
Rows80..127 still execute zero-key rounds; compression output is row79.
No full NEAR state-transition proof,1Pgas capacity measurement,sub-300KB proof,or128-bit quantum-security proof.
